text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- In the first half of 1997 the number of registered unemployed was 10.3 percent.
- By Thursday's deadline, only half of television licence fee forms had arrived at the Hungarian post office.
- The danger of flooding of the Koros river in eastern Hungary has passed. Forecasts show that no further floods can be expected.

- 10,200 soldiers and 1,600 border guards will complete their military service on Friday. These will be the last conscripts to have served twelve months as national service was reduced in January to nine months.
